findings.title: Reporter tightens the accepted producer metric contract to exact equality
findings.detail: The producer strict evaluation and established verifier accept each metric within an absolute 1e-5 percentage-point difference from the selected training row. R1 requires dictionary equality. A selected mAP 50.0 and strict receipt mAP 50.000005 satisfy the actual producer assertion but are rejected by the report. This is a concrete source-contract mismatch, not evidence that a new endpoint actually drifted.
findings.minimal_fix: Use the existing all(abs(receipt metrics[name] - selected official_fused[name]) < 1e-5 for name in receipt metrics) contract. Keep selected epoch, receipt, checkpoint and distance checks unchanged.

findings.title: Raw comparator batch-order bytes are consumed without their registered digest check
findings.detail: The current seal already pins all three raw-semantic training_batch_order.jsonl files, but source_map checks source entries only and the report checks only equality to whatever bytes presently occupy the old path. Equal candidate/control fixture files with a changed record are accepted even when the old file fails its registered hash. No production alteration is alleged.
findings.minimal_fix: Before read_bytes, assert the old_order_path SHA equals seal[artifact_sha256][str(old_order_path)]; retain the exact byte equality check.

A_ground_truth_provenance.detail: Producer identity/camera/scene arrays come directly from sealed protocol records, independently of predictions. Extraction traverses full query and gallery loaders, checks their declared counts and stores all distance rows/columns. The protocol builder reads dataset record manifests and copies identity/environment metadata; it is a supplementary unsealed reference, not a claimed sealed producer. Three local protocol JSON hashes match the current artifact seal; all 836/591/1715 queries have legal positives, with 836/1055/8575 gallery records. No image or tensor payload was inspected.

B_score_normalization.detail: AP is mean precision at legal positive ranks; CMC uses the first positive rank over the complete query denominator. Same-identity/same-scene or same-camera entries are excluded, while different-identity distractors remain. No metric denominator uses a model maximum, minimum or mean. L2 feature preprocessing defines the distance geometry and is separate from score normalization. Four Rank-1 transition AP contributions use total query count, sum to total delta mAP, and repairs minus new errors reproduces delta Rank-1. Worst tail uses the smallest ceil(0.05*N) signed query AP deltas without clipping.

C_result_existence_and_acceptance.detail: The report requires the requested job COMPLETE, ordered prepare/m0/train/evaluate stages each COMPLETE/exit0, matching official receipt, seed42/full50, matching comparison, checkpoint/distance hashes, all fifty history epochs and latest-tie mAP-best. The unchanged producer reconstructs, strict-loads and scores that best before creating official_metrics.json. R1 adds the incompatible exact-metric check F1. Actual supplied snapshots remain RUNNING (last witness 2026-10-12T19:46:37.472459+08:00); no complete50 result is accepted by this audit.

D_called_source_functions.detail: The configuration chain wires the actual region loss/stat producer into foundation training; formal loss values and batch-order rows are written by the inspected training/logger functions. Report main calls descriptor and paired for raw semantic and independent global, and paired calls the actual camera/scene scorers. The independent global comparator is named independently; own-model global/local decomposition is expressly deferred. Strict selected-best evaluation is the actual foundation evaluate entry, not dead alternate code.

E_scope_order_timing_and_claims.detail: History epochs, step totals, per-epoch step counts and ordered step/batch identities are checked. Existing raw control logs are compared byte-for-byte, but F2 omits their available seal pin. A completed job can be reported while another endpoint runs; no whole-campaign terminal or new numerical/kernel gate is required. This is one seed42 selected-best descriptive diagnosis of development-consumed official benchmarks, not seed uncertainty, causality, a uniform-versus-ambiguity result, own-global/local performance or a stronger-teacher/SOTA result. Timing and both partition memory fields are actually produced; detailed boundaries are recorded below.

F_evaluation_type.detail: Intended retrieval evaluation uses dataset metadata GT. Audit fixtures are simulation_only scalar/text checks, not neural evidence. Actual endpoint performance acceptance is pending.

provenance_limits: No completed original region-use endpoint is included. Actual witnesses show RGBNT201 uniform training still active; the available one-epoch scalar is not a full50 or selected-best result. No current performance number is endorsed.

Production-authored campaign state, stage exits and metrics receipts are consistency evidence, not an independent proof of execution or honest dataset/binary contents. This source review does not replay checkpoints, inspect tensor payloads or certify remote receipt authenticity.

timing_boundaries.producer_wall_seconds: Stage timestamps after Popen through process wait completion. Includes construction/training/per-epoch evaluation/save/process teardown; excludes prelaunch GPU wait, prepare, M0 and the separate strict-evaluation stage.
timing_boundaries.training_and_epoch_evaluation_interval_s: Foundation receipt begins after model/optimizer/loader construction and ends after training, evaluations, saves and final state diagnostics, before the terminal training.json write and partition-memory wrapper write.
timing_boundaries.training_loop_seconds: Sum of per-epoch seconds captured after scheduler/data/updates/logging and before that epoch's evaluation/checkpoint save.
timing_boundaries.partition_peak_memory: Both cuda:0 and cuda:1 allocated/reserved peaks are captured by the wrapper. GPU1 resets during optimization before optimizer construction; GPU0 resets again before the training loop. These are reported producer counters, not symmetric whole-process/construction high-water marks.
